event.text: Please go to an emergency department now; if you feel faint, can't stay awake, or have no safe ride, call 911 instead of driving yourself. Your combination of severe cramping pain, a bloated belly, repeated vomiting and no bowel movement for three days needs urgent hands-on assessment and imaging today. I recommend Counsel stay involved in this thread, but do not wait for a reply here.
